summary: Zhihu Inc. filed a Form 6-K announcing the results of its annual general meeting held on June 30, 2026. The meeting ratified the re-election of directors, approved general mandates to issue and repurchase shares, and adopted an amended share incentive plan. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, going-private transaction, or restructuring was disclosed. This is a routine corporate governance report with no substantive deal terms or strategic changes.
